summary: This document is an electronic invoice (number 42183017) issued on August 3, 2014, by Amazon Web Services, Inc. to iViveLabs Limited. The charges comprise AWS services including Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud, Amazon Glacier, AWS Data Transfer, and Amazon Simple Storage Service, with no taxes applied.
